SELECT cls, count(*) n, count(distinct boat) nboats, count(distinct fish_date_doy) ndays,
  sum(yt)::float/sum(anglers) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy<=60
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY ypa DESC

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, count(*) n, sum(yt)::float/sum(anglers) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 33 AND 60 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter')
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

SELECT boat, cls, count(*) n, sum(yt)::float/sum(anglers) ypa, avg(anglers) avg_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy<=60 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter')
GROUP BY boat, cls
HAVING count(*)>=3
ORDER BY ypa DESC
LIMIT 20
